title: LEGOLAND® Discovery Center Michigan Admission Ticket
blurb: Unleash your kids' creativity at LEGOLAND® Discovery Center Michigan, a family-friendly indoor LEGO® playground packed with fun attractions. Explore a virtual LEGO Factory, discover iconic Metro Detroit landmarks in Miniland, and build with soft bricks at the DUPLO® Farm. Enjoy exciting LEGO rides like Merlin’s Apprentice and relax at the 4D cinema for a full day of unforgettable LEGO® adventures.
